'''Maddor Rist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of [[House Rist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he hired a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to assassinate [[Zacar Girard]] of the [[House Girard]].<ref name="Silver Tongues" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maddor Rist is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
